question: If Hero of Bladehold's token-creating ability resolves before its battle cry ability, do the new Soldier tokens get +1/+0?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: if the token-creating ability resolves first, the tokens get +1/+0 from battle cry.
expected.answer: Whenever Hero of Bladehold attacks, both abilities will trigger. You can put them onto the stack in any order. If the token-creating ability resolves first, the tokens each get +1/+0 until end of turn from the battle cry ability.

whyHard: Both triggers happen together, so the order they are put on the stack matters, and players think it does not.
